title: CPL 2026 Schedule Announced: 39 Matches Across 8 Host Venues
label: Fixtures
excerpt: The CPL 2026 calendar covers eight Caribbean host venues across 45 days of T20 cricket, starting in St Vincent on 7 August and ending with the final at Kensington Oval on 20 September.
body: Caribbean Premier League 2026 officially spans 39 matches from 7 August to 20 September 2026. The schedule is split into group-stage legs hosted across St Vincent, Jamaica, Saint Lucia, Antigua, St Kitts, Trinidad, Guyana and Barbados. The Eliminator, Qualifier 1, Qualifier 2 and final are all scheduled at Kensington Oval, Barbados. The tournament features seven franchises, with the top four advancing to the playoffs after 35 group-stage matches.

title: CPL 2026 Teams and Squads: All Seven Franchises Profiled
label: Squads
excerpt: From Trinbago Knight Riders to Antigua & Barbuda Falcons, here is a breakdown of all seven CPL 2026 franchises, their home venues, team colours and squad identity.
body: CPL 2026 features seven franchises each representing a Caribbean nation. Trinbago Knight Riders (Trinidad & Tobago) are historically the most successful side. Guyana Amazon Warriors bring consistent pressure cricket from Providence Stadium. Jamaica Kingsmen return with island energy at Sabina Park. Barbados Tridents play their home matches at Kensington Oval. Saint Lucia Kings bring explosive batting from Gros Islet. St Kitts & Nevis Patriots play high-tempo T20 at Warner Park. Antigua & Barbuda Falcons are the newest-branded franchise at Sir Vivian Richards Stadium.

title: Top 5 Players to Watch in CPL 2026
label: Players
excerpt: Nicholas Pooran, Andre Russell, Shai Hope, Alzarri Joseph and Imran Tahir headline the names fans should track throughout CPL 2026.
body: CPL 2026 is set to feature some of the biggest names in T20 cricket. Nicholas Pooran returns with Trinbago Knight Riders, while Andre Russell is listed in the confirmed Jamaica Kingsmen local-player group. Shai Hope and overseas signing Imran Tahir are part of the Guyana Amazon Warriors roster, and Alzarri Joseph has joined Antigua & Barbuda Falcons. Any runs and wickets shown on CPL Insider before the 2026 opener are labelled as previous-season context rather than current-season statistics.

title: CPL 2026 Venues Guide: Every Stadium and What to Expect
label: Venues
excerpt: From Sabina Park in Jamaica to Kensington Oval in Barbados, CPL 2026 brings T20 cricket to some of the most iconic grounds in the Caribbean.
body: CPL 2026 is played at eight iconic Caribbean venues. Arnos Vale Stadium (St Vincent) hosts the tournament opener and early group matches. Sabina Park (Kingston, Jamaica) is known for its passionate crowd and fast pitch. Daren Sammy Cricket Ground (Gros Islet, Saint Lucia) offers a stunning tropical setting. Sir Vivian Richards Stadium (Antigua) carries the legacy of West Indian cricket royalty. Warner Park (Basseterre, St Kitts) is compact and generates intense home support. Brian Lara Stadium (Tarouba, Trinidad) is among the newest venues in the region. Providence Stadium (Georgetown, Guyana) is the Warriors' fortress. Kensington Oval (Bridgetown, Barbados) hosts all four playoff matches including the Final.

title: How to Watch CPL 2026 Live: TV Channels and Streaming
label: Broadcast
excerpt: CPL 2026 TV and streaming availability will vary by country. This guide explains where confirmed rights information will appear and how to check it safely.
body: Rush Live & Louder is confirmed as a television home for the 2026 men's and women's CPL in the Caribbean, with availability through major cable and television networks across the region. Exact provider availability can vary. Other international markets remain labelled To be announced until a direct tournament or rights-holder source confirms the TV channel, streaming platform, subscription requirement and geographic restrictions.

title: CPL 2026 Draft and Squad Build: What Fans Need to Know
label: Squads
excerpt: The CPL player draft and retention process shapes every team's identity. Here is how CPL 2026 squads are built and what the selection rules mean for fans.
body: The CPL confirmed 12 West Indian players for each of the seven franchises after the 15 May draft. Every franchise has now published its overseas contingent, so CPL Insider lists 122 officially announced players across all seven teams. Jamaica Kingsmen and Antigua & Barbuda Falcons have phased availability or replacement arrangements, which is why their announcement totals exceed 17 names. Captain and coach fields remain To be announced until those roles are explicitly confirmed.
